categories.main_business_segments: HealthyWay Inc. operates primarily in two business segments: (i) health and medical services, which include medical support services such as health membership schemes and medical consultation, and value-based medical services including healthcare service packages and pharmaceutical sales; and (ii) corporate and digital marketing services, comprising corporate services (content services and information technology services) and digital marketing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages digital platforms and internet technologies to provide health and medical services. It has developed an AI medical assistant that simulates physician consultation processes through AI-driven patient interactions to collect medical information and generate pre-consultation reports. The R&D department focuses on technological improvements and technical service support, including advanced tools to enhance consultation efficiency and medical service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: HealthyWay serves individual users, registered physicians, hospitals, corporate clients, pharmaceutical companies, and advertisers. Its platform supports over 205 million registered individual users, nearly 889 thousand registered physicians, and connects with over 11,700 hospitals. Corporate customers include pharmaceutical companies and other entities requiring content and IT services, as well as advertisers seeking digital marketing solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and major business operations in Fuzhou, Fujian Province. It also has a principal place of business in Hong Kong and subsidiaries in various Chinese mainland locations including Zhejiang, Fujian, Yinchuan, and Hubei.
categories.supply_chain_position: HealthyWay operates mainly as a digital health service platform provider, positioned midstream in the healthcare supply chain. It connects patients, physicians, hospitals, and pharmaceutical companies through its digital platform, facilitating medical consultations, health management, pharmaceutical sales, and digital marketing services without direct manufacturing or upstream production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in digital health services, focusing on AI-driven medical assistants, real-world study (RWS) support services, and integration of physician services onto its platform. It aims to deepen physician engagement, expand real-world clinical data access, and enhance synergies across business segments to drive revenue growth and improve cost efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams including sales of health membership schemes, medical consultation services, healthcare service packages, pharmaceutical sales, corporate content and IT services, and digital marketing services. Revenue recognition occurs both at a point in time and over time depending on the service type, with corporate and digital marketing services constituting the majority of revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: HealthyWay positions itself as a pioneer and leading player in China's digital health and medical services industry, recognized as a Future Unicorn Innovative Enterprise and ranked among the Top 100 Medical Services Companies in China. It competes by leveraging a large user base, strong industry relationships, innovative technology, and comprehensive service offerings, though specific competitors are not named in the report.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.2 billion in 2024, a slight decrease from RMB 1.24 billion in 2023, with a net loss of RMB 269 million in 2024, improving from RMB 314 million in 2023. It has shown significant growth in registered users, physicians, and hospital connections. The company’s net assets turned positive in 2024, reflecting improved financial health post-listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in December 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HealthyWay emphasizes its integrated digital health platform that supports patients throughout their health and disease management journey, from consultation to treatment and pharmaceutical purchase. Its AI medical assistant enhances consultation efficiency and experience. The company’s large user base, extensive physician network, innovative technology, and multi-dimensional services create synergies that differentiate it in the Chinese digital health market.
